It transforms Link into [[Fierce Deity Link]], where Link has a unique, very tall adult form and voice, and allows him to manifest the [[Fierce Deity Sword]]. His attack power and range is greatly increased (roughly the same as the Great Fairy Sword), and his sword can release [[Sword Beam]]s at the cost of [[Magic]]. When obtained, it is suggested to be as dangerous as [[Majora's Mask (Item)|Majora's Mask]]. Link can obtain the Fierce Deity's Mask by trading the twenty non-transformation Masks to the four [[Moon Child]]ren. Since the [[Deku Mask]], [[Goron Mask]], and the [[Zora Mask]] cannot be traded, Link must have in his possession all of the other Masks before being able to receive the Fierce Deity's Mask. Once this has been done, the young hero obtains the Mask from the child wearing Majora's Mask. He gives him the Mask so that the two of them can "play" together. It is said to possess the merits of all Masks. The Fierce Deity's Mask can only be used during [[Boss]] battles, and, in {{MM3D}}, [[Fishing Hole]]s. However, its combat capabilities are disabled inside Fishing Holes, and the [[Fishing Hole Men]] will forbid Link from leaving while wearing it. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Descriptions BotW}} The Fierce Deity Mask is a piece of [[Armor]] in {{BotW}}. It is obtained by scanning the {{MM|-}} [[Link]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. According to its description, the Fierce Deity Mask is the same [[Mask]] as the one worn by Link in the [[Era of the Hero of Time]], although it no longer retains its powers that it once had.{{Cite|Legends say this mask was once worn by a hero from a world in which the moon threatened to fall. It looks scary, but wearing it offers fierce, godlike power.|Inventory|BotW}} When worn, the Fierce Deity Mask provides one level of [[Attack Up]]. Like [[Majora's Mask (Item)|Majora's Mask]], the eyes of the Fierce Deity Mask glow allowing them to be seen in dark areas such as the [[Thyphlo Ruins]]. The Fierce Deity Mask can be enhanced by a [[Great Fairy]], though it cannot be [[Dye|Hateno Dye]]d at the [[Kochi Dye Shop]]. The Fierce Deity Mask, alongside the [[Fierce Deity Armor]] and [[Fierce Deity Boots]], compose the [[Fierce Deity Set]]. ====Enhancing==== {{Armor Levels|BotW|Fierce Deity Mask}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Descriptions TotK}} {{Stub|TotK}} ====Enhancing==== {{Armor Levels|TotK|Fierce Deity Mask}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{HW|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Fierce Deity's Mask appears as a pair of [[Attack Badge]]s, [[Fierce Deity's Mask I]] and [[Fierce Deity's Mask II]], in the [[Badge Market]] in {{HW}}. Both [[Badge]]s give [[Warrior]]s an additional [[Special Attack Gauge]] when crafted, allowing Warriors to have up to three Gauges. Introduced in {{HW}}'s {{MMP}}, Fierce Deity Masks are tier 1 [[Mask]] [[Weapon]]s usable by [[Young Link]]. They are associated with the [[Element]] of [[Darkness]]. Young Link can also use the Fierce Deity Mask to temporarily transform into [[Fierce Deity Link]] during [[Focus Spirit]] with the Mask, as well briefly during his [[Special Attack]]. While in Focus Spirit, Young Link can manifest the [[Fierce Deity Sword]], and his attack power, speed and range is heightened for the duration of the Focus Spirit. As Young Link is able to play the [[Ocarina of Time (Item)|Ocarina of Time]] to empty his Special Attack Gauges and fill his [[Magic Gauge]], it is possible for Young Link to stay in his Focus Spirit for lengthy periods of time. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== [[File:MM Link Mask Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The adult Link Mask in an earlier version of {{MM|-}}]] *Despite not being required to complete the game, [[Link]] obtaining the Fierce Deity's Mask is stated to be canon in {{HH}}. *In the Japanese text of the game, the child wearing [[Majora's Mask (Item)|Majora's Mask]] specifically states that he wants to play tag with Link. This is a play on words as the Japanese text states that the Fierce Deity's Mask is a mask an {{Wp|oni}} (a type of Japanese ogre) wears, and the Japanese name for tag is "pretending to be an oni." *In the original Nintendo 64 version of {{MM|-}}, when the Fierce Deity's Mask is first obtained after trading all 20 non-transformation Masks, a glitch prevents the use of the other transformation Mask against [[Majora]]. This was fixed in {{MM3D|-}}. *Early screenshots of {{MM|-}} show an adult Link Mask that was most likely replaced by Fierce Deity's Mask. In {{HH|-}}, the {{MM|-}} section contains concept art of Adult Link, stating that it could have been a prototype of Fierce Deity Link.{{Cite Book|book= HH|page= 151}} *Through a glitch, it is possible to use this mask without being in boss rooms. *[[Eiji Aonuma]] suggested that Fierce Deity's Mask contained the memories of all the residents of Termina. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}}
